selection: D3/D4 and H1/H4 are unchanged boxes from the R233 eight-section proposal. R234 did not name a four-box subset; this subset was declared before R235 candidate evaluation. Raw pixels were previously inspected. Reserved means no parameter tuning, not unseen image.
method: Frozen R231 M4 colored proposals plus all R192 dark-reflection records with successful native reflection and dark-surround evidence (including reflection-only records). No new thresholds, duplicate suppression, edge recovery or fitting. Evaluate before assisted corrections.

eligibility.colored: Distinct red/yellow body with convincing color and approximately >=10% of its unobstructed projected footprint visible; exact center or mask not required.
eligibility.black: Obvious recognizable specular reflection plus surrounding dark-body evidence; location is not physical center.
eligibility.deferred: Black without recognizable reflection remains unresolved, excluded from Stage 1 miss denominator.
eligibility.section_boundary: Reference representative lies in the half-open box; use 30px halo to judge actual visibility, not crop-truncated area. Border-intersecting bodies with a representative inside are retained. Halo-only proposals are context, not scored. Unassigned in-box proposals are never silently excluded.
eligibility.area_estimate: Agent-estimated visible width/height. Visible area bracket = [0.50,0.85]*w*h; unobstructed area bracket = [0.65,1.05]*local_full_width*local_full_height from nearby broad bodies and local orientation. Ratio range clipped to [0,1]. Heuristic area proxy, not a measured silhouette or confidence interval. Null when identity/color/extent is too ambiguous. Threshold-straddling small patches explicitly unresolved; black eligibility does not use area.

reference_policy: Agent provisional visual interpretation from raw crops/halos before candidate overlay inspection. Not maker confirmation or independent ground truth. Freeze file/hash before adjudication; subsequent discoveries must be append-only amendments. No observations read by candidate assembly.
success: Every clearly eligible reference body correctly covered exactly once, zero known false positives/duplicates/wrong colors in both reserved sections; reference uncertainty is separate and blocks a complete-map claim. Assisted completion is not automatic detector success.
tuning: None. Existing frozen methods replayed identically in all four sections. No held-out-specific repair.
geometry: No model-predicted bodies, physical centers, bead_index, count, helicity, spline fit, stretch or pattern inference in this pilot.
